entities.name: Theocracy & Divine Rule
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A system of government in which religious leaders or divine law constitutes the governing authority. From ancient Egyptian pharaohs claiming divine status to the Papal States and Calvin's Geneva, theocratic governance has shaped legal codes, social hierarchies, and political legitimacy across civilizations.
